mapper.sql: SELECT j.*,u.display_name requested_by_name,a.original_file_name,a.stored_file_name,a.content_type,a.file_size,a.storage_path FROM export_job j LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id=j.requested_by LEFT JOIN attachment_file a ON a.id=j.file_id
mapper.select: WHERE j.farm_id=#{farmId} AND j.client_request_id=#{clientRequestId} FOR UPDATE
WHERE j.farm_id=#{farmId} ORDER BY j.requested_at DESC,j.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM export_job WHERE farm_id=#{farmId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_logpest_control_log harvest_logsales_log WHERE farm_id=#{farmId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND work_dateapply_date harvest_datesales_date BETWEEN #{dateFrom} AND #{dateTo}

SELECT * FROM export_job j WHERE (j.status='REQUESTED' OR (j.status='PROCESSING' AND (j.lease_until IS NULL OR j.lease_until<#{now}))) AND j.attempt_count<#{maxAttempts} ORDER BY j.requested_at,j.id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM export_job j WHERE j.status='PROCESSING' AND (j.lease_until IS NULL OR j.lease_until<#{now}) AND j.attempt_count>=#{maxAttempts} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE export_job SET lease_until=#{leaseUntil},updated_at=NOW(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING' AND claim_token=#{claimToken}

UPDATE export_job SET status='REQUESTED',lease_until=NULL,claim_token=NULL,error_code=#{errorCode},error_message=#{errorMessage},updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING' AND claim_token=#{claimToken}

UPDATE export_job SET status='FAILED',lease_until=NULL,claim_token=NULL,error_code=#{errorCode},error_message=#{errorMessage},completed_at=#{now},updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING' AND claim_token=#{claimToken}

UPDATE export_job SET status='FAILED',lease_until=NULL,claim_token=NULL,error_code=#{errorCode},error_message=#{errorMessage},completed_at=#{now},updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING' AND attempt_count>=#{maxAttempts} AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<#{now})

UPDATE export_job SET status='COMPLETED',file_id=#{fileId},completed_at=#{completedAt},expires_at=#{expiresAt},lease_until=NULL,claim_token=NULL,error_code=NULL,error_message=NULL,updated_at=#{completedAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING' AND claim_token=#{claimToken}
UPDATE export_job SET status='EXPIRED',updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='COMPLETED'
mapper.select: WHERE j.status='COMPLETED' AND j.expires_at<=#{now} ORDER BY j.expires_at,j.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE attachment_file SET deleted_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

choose.when: SELECT l.id,l.work_date record_date,z.name zone_name,c.name crop_name,v.name variety_name,s.name season_name, wt.name work_type_name,NULL customer_name,l.worker_count,l.work_hours,NULL chemical_name,NULL target_pest, NULL dilution_ratio,NULL amount_value,NULL amount_unit,NULL preharvest_interval_days,NULL grade,NULL quantity, NULL unit,NULL package_unit,NULL item_name,NULL unit_price,NULL gross_amount,NULL fee_amount,NULL net_amount, NULL settlement_status,l.memo,l.farmer_confirm_status,u.display_name created_by_name,l.created_at FROM work_log l LEFT JOIN farm_zone z ON z.id=l.zone_id LEFT JOIN crop c ON c.id=l.crop_id LEFT JOIN crop_variety v ON v.id=l.variety_id LEFT JOIN crop_season s ON s.id=l.season_id AND s.farm_id=l.farm_id LEFT JOIN work_type wt ON wt.id=l.work_type_id AND wt.farm_id=l.farm_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id=l.created_by WHERE l.farm_id=#{farmId} AND l.deleted_at IS NULL AND l.work_date BETWEEN #{dateFrom} AND #{dateTo} AND l.farmer_confirm_status IN ('NOT_REQUIRED','CONFIRMED') ORDER BY l.work_date,l.id

SELECT l.id,l.apply_date record_date,z.name zone_name,c.name crop_name,v.name variety_name,s.name season_name, NULL work_type_name,NULL customer_name,NULL worker_count,NULL work_hours,l.chemical_name,l.target_pest, l.dilution_ratio,l.amount_value,l.amount_unit,l.preharvest_interval_days,NULL grade,NULL quantity,NULL unit, NULL package_unit,NULL item_name,NULL unit_price,NULL gross_amount,NULL fee_amount,NULL net_amount, NULL settlement_status,l.memo,l.farmer_confirm_status,u.display_name created_by_name,l.created_at FROM pest_control_log l LEFT JOIN farm_zone z ON z.id=l.zone_id LEFT JOIN crop c ON c.id=l.crop_id LEFT JOIN crop_variety v ON v.id=l.variety_id LEFT JOIN crop_season s ON s.id=l.season_id AND s.farm_id=l.farm_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id=l.created_by WHERE l.farm_id=#{farmId} AND l.deleted_at IS NULL AND l.apply_date BETWEEN #{dateFrom} AND #{dateTo} AND l.farmer_confirm_status IN ('NOT_REQUIRED','CONFIRMED') ORDER BY l.apply_date,l.id

SELECT l.id,l.harvest_date record_date,z.name zone_name,c.name crop_name,v.name variety_name,s.name season_name, NULL work_type_name,NULL customer_name,NULL worker_count,NULL work_hours,NULL chemical_name,NULL target_pest, NULL dilution_ratio,NULL amount_value,NULL amount_unit,NULL preharvest_interval_days,l.grade,l.quantity, LOWER(TRIM(l.unit)) unit,l.package_unit,NULL item_name,NULL unit_price,NULL gross_amount,NULL fee_amount,NULL net_amount, NULL settlement_status,l.memo,l.farmer_confirm_status,u.display_name created_by_name,l.created_at FROM harvest_log l LEFT JOIN farm_zone z ON z.id=l.zone_id LEFT JOIN crop c ON c.id=l.crop_id LEFT JOIN crop_variety v ON v.id=l.variety_id LEFT JOIN crop_season s ON s.id=l.season_id AND s.farm_id=l.farm_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id=l.created_by WHERE l.farm_id=#{farmId} AND l.deleted_at IS NULL AND l.harvest_date BETWEEN #{dateFrom} AND #{dateTo} AND l.farmer_confirm_status IN ('NOT_REQUIRED','CONFIRMED') ORDER BY l.harvest_date,l.id
choose.otherwise: SELECT l.id,l.sales_date record_date,NULL zone_name,NULL crop_name,NULL variety_name,NULL season_name, NULL work_type_name,c.name customer_name,NULL worker_count,NULL work_hours,NULL chemical_name,NULL target_pest, NULL dilution_ratio,NULL amount_value,NULL amount_unit,NULL preharvest_interval_days,NULL grade,l.quantity, LOWER(TRIM(l.unit)) unit,NULL package_unit,l.item_name,l.unit_price,l.gross_amount,l.fee_amount,l.net_amount, l.settlement_status,l.memo,l.farmer_confirm_status,u.display_name created_by_name,l.created_at FROM sales_log l LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.id=l.customer_id AND c.farm_id=l.farm_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id=l.created_by WHERE l.farm_id=#{farmId} AND l.deleted_at IS NULL AND l.sales_date BETWEEN #{dateFrom} AND #{dateTo} AND l.farmer_confirm_status IN ('NOT_REQUIRED','CONFIRMED') ORDER BY l.sales_date,l.id
